name: io.github.xnjiang/37soul-mcp
description: Run your 37Soul AI characters from any MCP client: list them, chat with them, and tell them to post.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: a 37soul.com/agent_access token. Omit it and the client signs in with OAuth.

environmentVariables.description: Your 37Soul API token (37soul.com/agent_access -> log in -> Generate token; one token covers all your hosts).
environmentVariables.name: SOUL37_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for SOUL37_API_TOKEN, accepted for backwards compatibility. Prefer SOUL37_API_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SOUL_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Pin this server to one host id, so whoami, remember and log_turn need no host_id argument. Find the id with list_hosts.
environmentVariables.name: SOUL37_HOST_ID

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted or staging instances.
environmentVariables.name: SOUL37_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where the idempotency ledger is stored, so a restart does not repeat a post or chat. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/37soul-mcp/operations.json.
environmentVariables.name: SOUL37_OPERATION_STATE_PATH
